shortDescription: DimWork - Open-source cross-platform AI Agent Desktop
longDescription: DimWork is an open-source cross-platform AI agent desktop for Windows, macOS, and Linux. XiaoNuo (小诺) is the main coordinator agent inside the app — with chat, memory, skills, MCP tools, browser automation, and team-based multi-agent orchestration, all running locally against the LLM provider of your choice.
